title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - ComputeFunctionQuotas
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/ComputeFunctionQuotas. Attributes describing quotas for compute functions.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'ComputeFunctionQuotas'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

functionMaximumNumber.description: Property. Maximum number of functions that can be created.

functionStorageLimit.description: Relationship. Storage limit for deployed functions. Links to a MemorySize entity.

functionTimeLimit.description: Relationship. Maximum execution time for a function. Links to a Time entity.

functionMemoryLimit.description: Relationship. Maximum amount of memory usable by a function. Links to a MemorySize entity.

functionSizeLimit.description: Relationship. Maximum size of a deployed function. Links to a MemorySize entity.

functionConcurrencyLimit.description: Property. Maximum number of concurrent executions of a function.

functionRequestSizeLimit.description: Relationship. Maximum size for an incoming request (or triggering event) for a function. Links to a MemorySize entity.

functionResponseSizeLimit.description: Relationship. Maximum size for a function response. Links to a MemorySize entity.
